updates.source: Source: [dated camp observations](career/2014/Training_Camp_and_Preseason/Training_Camp/training_report.md). This coaching update preserves the opening grades above.

short.text: Sio Moore played in all {{2013.regular.games}} regular-season games as a rookie in 2013, working as a package linebacker in a rotation role. He is athletic, covers ground and has useful tools for pressuring the quarterback, and the coverage corrections he was given in his first spring held when the looks changed. His reading of the run and his fit discipline are behind his movement and need to become dependable before his job grows.

transactions.text: Drafted by Jacksonville with the No. 98 pick
Signed a four-year rookie contract with Jacksonville
